name: Oberkochen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the city arms of Oberkochen (three yellow roses on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Oberkochen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Oberkochen arms — three roses on blue
